About me
Hi, my name is Job Odijk. Currently I’m a master’s student Methodology, Statistics and Data Science at Utrecht University. I chose this master’s because of my love for data analysis and all the challanges that come with is. I see it as little puzzles to solve. Before the master’s I got a BSc degree in Sociology where i founded my remained interest in societal problems.
